own_solution.law: Constant-velocity and constant-acceleration kinematics: x_truck = v t, x_car = a t^2 / 2; equal positions give t = 2v/a
assumptions: straight road, both start level at t=0
car starts from rest with constant a = 2 m/s^2 (no top speed unless stated)

T35DB.regime: top speed irrelevant while v_max >= 2v = 30 m/s (car speed at the meeting); 46 m/s is inside

T76A7.regime: top speed irrelevant while v_max >= 30 m/s; 46 m/s is inside

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: TB52F and T0812 say 'adds a little' with no number, whereas the other tuning-kit sentences state 1.3 m/s^2, so if they are meant as variants of the numeric sentences they differ in the stated value.

notes: Top speed 21 m/s: car reaches 21 m/s at t = 10.5 s having covered 110.25 m; then 110.25 + 21(t - 10.5) = 15 t gives t = 18.375 s. Kit on car: a = 3.3 m/s^2, t = 30/3.3 = 9.0909 s (the problem says the stated 2 m/s^2 is as delivered, so the kit adds to it). Motorbike kit and earlier-run kit have no path to this run's meeting time. Pairing of 'a little' sentences with numeric ones cannot be confirmed until pass 2.
